results.title: Wuraren da aka samu rikice-rikice tun bayan fara yaƙin neman zaɓen 2027 a Najeriya
results.content: Tun daga lokacin da aka fara shirye-shiryen zaɓen 2027 a Najeriya, an fuskanci matsalolin hare-hare, musamman a wuraren tarukan siyasa da yaƙin zaɓe da sauran su.

results.title: Haaland na iya barin Man City, Liverpool na harin Jamal Musiala
results.content: Erling Haaland na duba yiuwar barin Manchester City exit, yayin da Liverpool ke harin Jamal Musiala, sai Manchester United da ke zawarcin Maxi Araujo, da arin wasu rahotannin.

results.title: Mene ne amfanin matatun man China idan Iran ba ta fitar da mai?

results.content: Tuku Nkosiyaphantsi ya gano cewa an kashe 'yarsa ne ta hanyar wani saƙo da aka wallafa a Facebook. Lamarin ya faru ne a watan Agusta.
